mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM material WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

WITH sums AS ( SELECT material_id, sum(quantity) AS movement_sum FROM stock_movement GROUP BY material_id ) SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.name AS name, coalesce(b.quantity, 0) AS balance, coalesce(s.movement_sum, 0) AS movement_sum FROM material m LEFT JOIN stock_balance b ON b.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN sums s ON s.material_id = m.id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND coalesce(b.quantity, 0) <> coalesce(s.movement_sum, 0) ORDER BY m.name
